scope: Proposition 7.1 (Natural roots of finite diagrams) of the manuscript “Finite generation for the K(n)-local sphere” (preprints/Finite-generation-for-the-Kn-local-sphere-September-24-2026/Finite-generation-for-the-Kn-local-sphere-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 313 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 07b43c6077268638), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 56. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume m > 1. With the powers in Equation (7.4), there is a natural G-equivariant isomorphism VCoindq(E) ≃ (VE)1/h . (7.5) It is compatible with the natural auxiliary actions and with every arrow of a finite diagram. It preserves exact diagrams and is compatible with successive coinduction and successive roots. For any fixed initial diagram, these assertions hold at every sufficiently deep finite marking stage, retaining the natural auxiliary action on each of its coinductions.
